compiled_state.title: Create RED tests: merge-to-main.sh dispatcher routing, CONFLICT_DATA schema, --resume cross-strategy rejection
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: tests confirm merge-to-main.sh routes to merge-to-main-direct.sh when merge.strategy=direct and to merge-to-main-pr.sh when merge.strategy=pr
- DD6: tests confirm CONFLICT_DATA output schema is identical between direct and PR modes
- DD7: tests confirm direct-mode regression (merge.strategy=direct behaves identically to pre-epic baseline)
- DD8: tests confirm merge-to-main.sh --resume rejects a direct-mode state file when current merge.strategy=pr

## TDD Requirement
This IS the RED test task. Write the following failing tests in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh:
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script: Given tmpdir with dso-config.conf setting merge.strategy=direct and stub merge-to-main-direct.sh that writes to a sentinel file; When merge-to-main.sh runs; Then sentinel file exists and merge-to-main-pr.sh was NOT invoked. FAILS: merge-to-main-pr.sh does not exist yet; dispatcher routing not implemented.
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script: Given merge.strategy=pr and stub merge-to-main-pr.sh; When merge-to-main.sh runs; Then pr stub invoked, direct stub not invoked. FAILS: same.
- test_conflict_data_schema_direct: Given merge.strategy=direct, simulated conflict; When merge-to-main.sh runs and outputs CONFLICT_DATA; Then stdout contains CONFLICT_DATA with fields: branch, base_branch, conflicted_files, resolution_strategy. FAILS: direct script split not done.
- test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent: Given merge.strategy=pr; When merge-to-main.sh runs and outputs CONFLICT_DATA; Then CONFLICT_DATA fields match direct mode exactly (same keys, same types). FAILS: merge-to-main-pr.sh does not exist.
- test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy: Given state file from merge.strategy=direct run; When merge-to-main.sh --resume run with merge.strategy=pr; Then exits non-zero and stderr contains 'strategy mismatch'. FAILS: merge.strategy not read, no rejection logic.
- test_direct_mode_regression_no_network: Given merge.strategy=direct and repo with no remote; When merge-to-main.sh runs; Then exits 1 with error containing 'no remote' (same as current baseline). Note: PASSES against current codebase but must be included to lock regression behavior.

## Implementation Notes
- Use mktemp -d for tmpdir; trap 'rm -rf "$_TMPDIR"' EXIT for cleanup
- Mock read-config by creating a fake dso-config.conf in tmpdir and passing PROJECT_ROOT=$_TMPDIR or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT override
- Stub scripts: write executable stubs to tmpdir/bin/ and prepend to PATH
- Source tests/lib/assert.sh for assert_eq, assert_contains helpers
- File naming: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh (fuzzy-match compatible with merge-to-main.sh)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] File contains all 6 test functions by exact name
  Verify: grep -q 'test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script\|test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\|test_conflict_data_schema_direct\|test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent\|test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy\|test_direct_mode_regression_no_network' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] Tests assert on subprocess output/exit codes (not source-file grep)
  Verify: grep -qv 'grep.*merge-to-main.sh' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh || true
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh tests
  Verify: grep -q 'test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script\|test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] bash -n syntax check passes
  Verify: bash -n tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

comments.body:
AC amendment: Specify exact .test-index RED marker entries.

For each test function in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh, add a .test-index entry in the format:
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_direct]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_direct_mode_regression_no_network]

Also add source-file mappings:
  plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh

Additional assertion for test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy: assert (a) non-zero exit code, (b) stderr contains BOTH the stored strategy and the current config strategy (not just 'strategy mismatch'), (c) state file is NOT deleted/mutated by the rejection run.

Verify: grep 'test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script\|test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\|merge-to-main.sh:.*test-merge-to-main-dispatcher' .test-index
